program: UPGRADE_CANDIDATES_V1 item 2, new asset classes, entered because Step 245 measured the equity construction's breadth at 8.5 effective bets per year and its IR ceiling below 0.1
question: Before building anything: how much breadth can a multi-asset universe actually supply, and is it the multiple Step 245 says is needed?
why_measurement_before_strategy: Step 245's lesson is that this project searches for IC and never measures BR. Building a cross-asset strategy first would repeat that. The claim being tested is that new asset classes add breadth; that claim is measurable directly and cheaply, and if it fails there is no reason to build the strategy at all.

not_a_retry_of.run_multi_asset_breakout_v1: rejected as a portfolio improvement; kept as a cross-asset baseline
not_a_retry_of.note: Both were return searches on this data and both failed. Neither measured breadth. This measures breadth and proposes no strategy.

method.effective_independent_assets: participation ratio of the asset return correlation matrix, the same estimator used in measure_effective_bets_v1 and in Step 245
method.against_null: E[PR] = N(T-1)/(T+N-2) if the assets were genuinely independent
method.breadth_projection: effective assets x rebalances per year x the independent share of each rebalance, matching the Step 245 accounting exactly so the two numbers are comparable
method.signal_persistence_estimated_from: autocorrelation of a 12-week trend signal at each rebalance frequency, because a signal that barely changes places no new bet

interpretation_fixed_in_advance.if_effective_assets_below_8: the multi-asset universe supplies no more independence than the equity book already has; option 1 is refuted on its own premise and should be abandoned rather than pursued with a strategy
interpretation_fixed_in_advance.if_effective_assets_8_to_15_and_projecte: a real improvement that still cannot reach an IR of 0.25 at the measured IC; report as insufficient and say so plainly rather than proceeding on hope
interpretation_fixed_in_advance.if_projected_breadth_at_or_above_91: the premise of option 1 holds and a strategy is worth building, subject to every existing gate; the projection is still an upper bound because it assumes an IC as good as the equity book's
interpretation_fixed_in_advance.always: breadth is capacity, not return. Nothing measured here is evidence that any cross-asset strategy makes money, and two have already been rejected on this data.

why_zero_trials: nothing is fitted and no strategy is selected; these are properties of a correlation matrix
